description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'CustomerTransaction' within the OpenCart admin extension for customer transaction reporting. The class handles actions such as displaying the report interface, saving settings, generating report data, and rendering views related to customer transactions.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer transaction reports in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads report configuration interface, including breadcrumbs and view rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of report settings, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer transaction report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the customer transaction list report.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for the customer transaction report, including filtering, pagination, and view rendering.
